scope: Follow-up to the initial all-Mollusca body correction. Corrects anatomical link integration and four anatomy descriptions; it adds no measured geometry, biological certification or finished physiological mechanism.
changes: 77 displayed regional labels bind to retained surface vertices or a sucker instance and follow their existing deformation/parent transform.
Octopus siphon link attaches to the actual funnel, and the sucker detail view removes the contextual platform.
Review of 77 final anatomical states rejected tangential/underside camera drafts; explicit regional view directions replace those drafts.

Cornu no longer claims an absent pedal wave. Oyster mantle tissue is marked not depicted. Mya posterior-shell and Pinna exposed-basal-region descriptions distinguish regions from absent siphons or sediment burial.
limitations: The models remain partly stylized and unmeasured. Macro views reveal regular numerical bands, simplified soft tissue, incomplete apertures and missing natural surface diversity. Some target structures remain partly occluded or dark; an attached link is not proof of complete anatomical depiction. Traction, mucus, food capture, filtration, jetting, fluid/contact forces and physiological development remain unfinished. Regional camera directions are display settings, not biological measurements.
licensing: Original numerical geometry/surface code follows the project MIT license. No organism photograph or AI image was generated. Reference pixels retain the exact individual creators and grants below. Each comparison sheet includes a resized reference; reuse it under that photograph’s applicable license, including attribution/share-alike where required. Do not apply MIT to the photographs.
